Coram:
 Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar , Judge.

The petitioner has filed the instant petition under Section 407 Cr.PC seeking transfer of challan titled UT of J&K trough P/s Womens Rambagh Srinagar Vs. Shabir Ahmad Dar and Others arising out of FIR No. 60/2022 for offences under Sections 498A, 506 of IPC of Police Station Womens Cell, Srinagar from the court of Judicial Magistrate 1st Class, Ganderbal to any other court of competent jurisdiction at Srinagar.
2. Notice of this petition was issued to the respondents on 20.09.2023 and the said notice has been received back duly served.
Only respondent Nos. 1 and 2 have caused their appearance and they have filed their reply.
In their reply, the respondents have narrated the facts relating to filing of the challan but have not commented about Page |2 the transfer of the challan.
The other respondents despite service did not cause their appearance.

3. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
4.

It appears that the petitioner who happens to be complainant had lodged an FIR against the private respondents before the SHO Police Station, Women Cell, Srinagar which resulted in registration of FIR No. 60/2022 for offences under Sections 498A and 506 of IPC.

The investigation of the said FIR culminated into filing of challan before the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Ganderbal and thereafter the said challan was transferred to the court of Judicial Magistrate 1 st Class, Ganderbal.

sentences.text: The petitioner has sought transfer of the challan on the ground that the investigation of the case has taken place in Srinagar and all the prosecution witnesses are residing in Srinagar.
It is further submitted that out of eight accused, five accused are residents of Srinagar and only three accused are residents of District Ganderbal.
On these grounds, it has been submitted that it would be convenient for the accused as well as for the prosecution tp pursue/defend the case at Srinagar.

6. Section 407 of the Code of Criminal Procedure vests powers upon High Court to transfer a case from criminal court subordinate to its authority to any other criminal court of competent jurisdiction.
One Page |3 of the grounds on which such an order can be made is when transfer of the case will tend to general convenience of the parties or witnesses.
A perusal of the challan shows that all the five prosecution witnesses cited in the challan are residents of Srinagar.
It is further revealed that out of eight accused, five are residents of District Srinagar.
It is also revealed that the investigation of the case has been conducted in Srinagar by Police Station Women Cell, Srinagar.
In view of this, it would be convenient for the witnesses as well as for all the accused as also the prosecution to pursue/defend the challan at Srinagar.

7. Accordingly the petition is allowed and the challan titled UT of J&K trough P/s Womens Rambagh Srinagar Vs. Shabir Ahmad Dar and Others pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate 1st Class Ganderbal is withdrawn from the docket of the said court and is transferred to the court of Judicial Magistrate 1st Class (2nd Additional Munsiff) Srinagar.
